title: General Economically Poor Scholarship Classes 6-8
eligibility: Students in Classes 6-8 in government schools
Parent/guardian annual income up to INR 1 lakh
Previous class must have been passed
BPL families may submit a BPL card copy
benefits: Annual scholarship: INR 200 for boys and INR 300 for girls
documents_required: Self-signed/self-certified income declaration from parent/guardian, or BPL card copy for BPL families
application_process: Student profile is entered by the school teacher on the Shiksha Portal based on submitted records.
important_sections_or_clauses: No application fee; payment is directly to the student's bank account.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
